wish: someone should make calendar apps that support approximate dates for to-do items
spec:
Keeps a to-do list where each item gets an approximate date: early, mid, late or any time in a month, season or year.
Type the to-do, pick roughly when, add; items group under their period in calendar order and show when a period has passed.
It does not sync, remind, or use exact dates; the list lives in this browser only.
